Imaging Department
Date: 21 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: PSA 5.0 ng/mL, rising trend. Prior biopsy Gleason 4+4.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume measured at 35.45 mL. T2-weighted images demonstrate a focal area of low signal intensity in the left peripheral zone at the base. This lesion demonstrates restricted diffusion on DWI (high b-value signal) with corresponding early enhancement on DCE. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle involvement is identified. No suspicious pelvic lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS v2.1 category 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone, base.
PSA density: 0.141 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical T stage: cTx.
csPCa predicted probability 0.7376658.
